Alternatives: ނިމުނު ބާކީ, ކްލޯޒިންގ ބެލެންސް. Keep parallel with print.opening_balance.
Loanword consistent with ސަރވިސް ޗާޖު. These are debits (credit sales/invoices) on the statement; alternative: ދަރަނި އިތުރުވުން or ޑެބިޓް (as in credit.debit).
Built on status_labels.overdue (މުއްދަތު ފަހަނައަޅާފައި), itself still needs_review. Alternative aligned with superadmin past_due: ލަސްވި ދުވަސް.
Same as status_labels.overdue; used as an amount column header, so ފައިސާ ލަސްވެފައި might fit better.
Follows credit.outstanding = ބާކީ ދަރަނި (needs_review there).
Alternative: ލިބުނު ފައިސާ (customer-facing vs business view — this PDF goes to the customer, so 'paid' wording chosen).
'Items' here means unpaid sales/invoices, not menu items. Alternative: ނުދައްކާ ބިލުތައް / ނުދައްކާ މުޢާމަލާތް.

english: Could not create the PDF. Try Print → Save as PDF instead.
suggested: PDF ހެދޭނެ ނުވި. އޭގެ ބަދަލުގައި ޕްރިންޓް → PDF ގެ ގޮތުގައި ސޭވްކުރޭ ބޭނުންކޮށްލާ.
notes: 'Save as PDF' is a browser dialog label that will likely appear in English; consider keeping it in Latin ('Save as PDF').
Loanword ރޯ (row). Dhivehi has no plural inflection after numerals; alternative: {{count}} ލައިން.
Date-range preset; alternative: ފެށުނީއްސުރެ.
Matches existing reports.types.credit. Alternative loanword: ކްރެޑިޓް އަދި ޑިއުސް. Depends on the pending ދަރަނި vs ކްރެޑިޓް decision (addons.names.credit).
Alternative: ޖުމްލަ ދަރަނި / ޖުމްލަ ބާކީ. Confirm which reads best on a dashboard tile.
Alternative: ކަސްޓަމަރުންގެ ބާކީ ރިޕޯޓް. Also printed on PDF given to staff/customers.
Reuses print.days_overdue phrasing; Dhivehi has no plural split so _one and _other are identical.
Distinguished from print.total (ޖުމްލަ). Alternative: ހުރިހާ ޖުމްލަ.
Shown next to a date; word order may need adjusting depending on layout (date follows label).

english: Viber notifications will be sent for Credit (Pay Later) transactions when the customer has a registered Viber number.
suggested: ކަސްޓަމަރުގެ Viber ނަންބަރު ރަޖިސްޓަރީކޮށްފައިވާނަމަ، ދަރަންޏަށް (ފަހުން ދައްކާ) ކުރާ މުޢާމަލާތްތަކަށް Viber ނޯޓިފިކޭޝަން ފޮނުވޭނެ.
notes: Loanword ނޯޓިފިކޭޝަން used; alternative: އެންގުން / ހަބަރު. Confirm preferred term.

english: Viber notifications are disabled. Credit transactions will continue normally.
suggested: Viber ނޯޓިފިކޭޝަން ބަންދުކޮށްފައި. ދަރަނީގެ މުޢާމަލާތްތައް އާދައިގެ ގޮތުގައި ކުރިއަށް ދާނެ.
notes: ބަންދު matches common.disabled. Same notification-term question as status_on.
Kept in Latin; alternative ހުޅުވާ is longer for a switch label.
Loanwords ސްޓޮކް/އައިޓަމް follow existing inventory strings. Alternative: ސްޓޮކަށް ތަކެއްޗެއް އިތުރުކުރޭ.

english: For things you use but don't sell, like a milk powder packet, cups or syrup. Tracked in stock, hidden from the POS.
suggested: ބޭނުންކުރާ ނަމަވެސް ނުވިއްކާ ތަކެތި، މިސާލަކަށް މިލްކް ޕައުޑަރު ޕެކެޓެއް، ކަޕު ނުވަތަ ސިރަޕް. ސްޓޮކުގައި ބަލަހައްޓާނެ، POSގައި ނުފެންނާނެ.
notes: Milk powder and cups rendered as loanwords (މިލްކް ޕައުޑަރު, ކަޕު); confirm local café usage (e.g. ކިރުގަނޑު).
ތަކެތި for ingredients matches products.add_ingredient; ސަޕްލައިސް is a loanword.
Matches common.enabled (ހުޅުވިފައި). Alternative: އެނޭބަލްކުރޭ.
Same as qr.title. Acronym QR kept in Latin letters per project rule; މެނޫ as in nav.menu.
މޭޒު as in tables.title (singular). Alternative: {{table}} ވަނަ މޭޒު if table names are numbers only.

english: Our staff will take your order
notes: މުވައްޒަފު as in public_menu.order_sent_body. Alternative more casual: ތިބާގެ އޯޑަރު މުވައްޒަފަކު ނަގާނެ.
Matches nav.qr_menu.

english: Customers scan the code at their table to see your menu. No printed menu books needed.
suggested: ކަސްޓަމަރުން އެމީހުންގެ މޭޒުމަތީގައިވާ ކޯޑު ސްކޭންކޮށް ތިބާގެ މެނޫ ބަލާނެ. ޕްރިންޓްކުރި މެނޫ ފޮތް ބޭނުމެއް ނުވޭ.
notes: ސްކޭންކޮށް as in superadmin.security.step_scan. 'Menu books' rendered as މެނޫ ފޮތް; alternative: ޕްރިންޓްކުރި މެނޫ ކާޑު.

english: This QR code never changes. When you edit items, prices or photos, the menu updates automatically.
suggested: މި QR ކޯޑު ދުވަހަކުވެސް ބަދަލެއް ނުވާނެ. އައިޓަމް، އަގު ނުވަތަ ފޮޓޯ ބަދަލުކުރާއިރު މެނޫ އަމިއްލައަށް އަޕްޑޭޓްވާނެ.
notes: 'Updates automatically' = އަމިއްލައަށް އަޕްޑޭޓްވާނެ (loanword as in products.image_updated). Alternative: އޮޓޮމެޓިކުން އަޕްޑޭޓްވާނެ.
Loanword ކޮޕީ is common in UI; native alternative ނަކަލުކުރޭ.
Short success toast. Alternative: ލިންކް ކޮޕީވެއްޖެ.
ހުޅުވާ as in nav.open_pos.
ސެޓިންގްސް as in nav.settings.

english: Customers can order from the menu
notes: Toggle label. Alternative: ކަސްޓަމަރުންނަށް މެނޫއިން އޯޑަރުކުރެވުން.

english: Customers can place orders themselves from their phone.
notes: 'Their phone' rendered as އަމިއްލަ ފޯނު (own phone). Check that it reads naturally.

english: Menu only. Customers browse the menu and your staff take the order.
suggested: މެނޫ ބެލުން އެކަނި. ކަސްޓަމަރުން މެނޫ ބަލާނެ، އަދި އޯޑަރު ނަގާނީ ތިބާގެ މުވައްޒަފުން.
notes: 'Menu only' = މެނޫ ބެލުން އެކަނި (viewing menu only). Alternative: ހަމައެކަނި މެނޫ.

english: e.g. Welcome! Call a waiter when you are ready to order.
suggested: މިސާލަކަށް: މަރުޙަބާ! އޯޑަރު ކުރަން ތައްޔާރުވީމަ ވެއިޓަރަކަށް ގޮވާލައްވާ.
notes: Placeholder example text. މަރުޙަބާ as in auth.invite_title; ވެއިޓަރު as in roles.system.waiter.

english: The menu is switched off. Customers who scan will see that it is unavailable.
suggested: މެނޫ ބަންދުކޮށްފައި. ސްކޭންކުރާ ކަސްޓަމަރުންނަށް ފެންނާނީ މެނޫ ނުލިބޭކަން.
notes: 'Switched off' = ބަންދުކޮށްފައި; alternative: ހުޅުވާފައެއް ނެތް (to mirror 'enable' = ހުޅުވާ). 'Unavailable' wording mirrors public_menu.not_found (މެނޫ ނުލިބޭ).
Plural implied without ތައް to stay short. Alternative: މޭޒުތަކުގެ QR ކާޑުތައް.

english: Print one card for each table. The card shows the table name, so staff know where the customer is sitting.
suggested: ކޮންމެ މޭޒަކަށް ކާޑެއް ޕްރިންޓްކުރޭ. ކާޑުގައި މޭޒުގެ ނަން ހުންނާތީ، ކަސްޓަމަރު އިށީނދެގެން ތިބީ ކޮންތާކުކަން މުވައްޒަފުންނަށް އެނގޭނެ.
notes: ޕްރިންޓްކުރޭ as in pos.print_receipt. 'Where the customer is sitting' = ކަސްޓަމަރު އިށީނދެގެން ތިބީ ކޮންތާކުކަން; please check naturalness.

english: No tables yet. Add tables to print a card for each one, or print a general card.
suggested: އަދި މޭޒެއް ނެތް. ކޮންމެ މޭޒަކަށް ކާޑެއް ޕްރިންޓްކުރުމަށް މޭޒުތައް އިތުރުކުރައްވާ، ނުވަތަ އާންމު ކާޑެއް ޕްރިންޓްކުރައްވާ.
notes: First sentence mirrors tables.empty_title. 'General card' = އާންމު ކާޑު (އާންމު as in addons.categories.general).
Numeral after noun (ކާޑު {{count}}) is natural Dhivehi word order; alternative: {{count}} ކާޑު.
Alternative: މޭޒަކާ ގުޅިފައިނުވާ ކާޑު (card not linked to a table).
Alternative: މިސާލަކަށް ލިންކް.
Printed on the card for customers, so polite ކުރައްވާ form. Shorter alternative: މެނޫއަށް ސްކޭންކުރޭ.

english: Point your phone camera at the code
notes: Customer-facing, polite. Literally 'hold the phone camera towards the code'. Alternative: ފޯނުގެ ކެމެރާއިން ކޯޑު ސްކޭންކުރައްވާ.
Same as public_menu.your_table.

english: Our staff will be with you shortly
suggested: އަޅުގަނޑުމެންގެ މުވައްޒަފަކު އަވަހަށް ތިބާގެ ގާތަށް އަންނާނެ
notes: Customer-facing. 'Shortly' = އަވަހަށް; alternative: ވަގުތުން (right away), which may over-promise.
